name: Open WebUI
description: User-friendly WebUI for LLMs. A self-hosted WebUI designed to run entirely offline. Supports Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

name: LangChain
description: Building applications with LLMs through composability. Official support and native integrations for Ollama models.

name: AnythingLLM
description: The all-in-one Desktop & Docker AI application with full RAG and AI Agent capabilities. One-click integration with Ollama.

name: LlamaIndex
description: Data framework for your LLM applications. Provides a central interface to connect your custom data sources to Ollama LLMs.

name: Ollama-Python
description: Official Python library for the Ollama API. Easily integrate local model inference into your Python scripts and backend apps.

name: Ollama Discord Bot
description: A simple Discord bot powered by Ollama. Let your community chat with local LLMs directly within your Discord server.

name: Ollama.js
description: Official JavaScript / TypeScript library for the Ollama API. Works in Node.js and browser environments.

name: Msty
description: A beautiful and simple desktop app for running LLMs locally with Ollama. Supports multi-model comparison and prompt templates.

name: n8n Ollama Node
description: Community n8n node that connects your automation workflows to local Ollama models for AI-powered processing.
